name: Ed Markey
stance: Opposes preempting state AI laws and wants independent federal investigation of AI-enabled cyber incidents.

statements.text: This 99-1 vote sent a clear message that Congress will not sell out our kids and local communities in order to pad the pockets of Big Tech billionaires.
I’ve led the charge to stop Trump’s outrageous efforts to block state AI regulations before. I’m ready to do it again.
We need to pass my AI Accountability agenda to address current harms now and act to stop existential threats to our future.

Introduced the Cybersecurity and AI Board of Investigations Act, an NTSB-style board to investigate major cyber incidents including those carried out by AI agents, prompted by the Hugging Face breach.
Building stronger defenses requires a full accounting of what goes wrong, and we cannot depend on companies with little incentive to disclose their failures to give us one.
We need a Cybersecurity & AI Board of Investigations to demand answers from the rogue people behind these “rogue agents.”
Donald Trump is like AI itself—over confident, often wrong, and prone to hallucinating facts. His “morally binding” agreement means nothing.
